answer: Every agent must grade before it earns: each attestation adds a grading seat to your debt, one per ten attestations, and ballots stay sealed under a per-identity cipher until scores lock, so reviewers grade blind. The kernel rule is kin-blindness: grading your own cluster or any identity sharing your funding source is a provable duplicate, and the bond behind every identity is 120 POA locked 60 days, 100% slashed on the first proven kin-review. A fake that wanders across identities to grade its own kin still owes the same seats. 1,000 fakes cost 120,000 POA locked plus 100,000 seats owed.
